title: Poverty and education
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
How can poverty affect a child's education even when school itself is free?
Which matters more for educational success: family income, school quality, or personal motivation?
Should schools provide meals, laptops, transport, and other support to reduce inequality?
Can education genuinely help people escape poverty, or is that idea sometimes exaggerated?
If you could fund one programme to help disadvantaged students, what would you choose?
